root = Card([header, counts, table, next])
header = CardHeader("Non-negotiables by subsystem", "17 rules from AGENTS.md:243–261, grouped into 6 subsystems")
counts = BarChart(["Sync & local data", "Identity & auth", "Telemetry", "Wire compatibility", "Renderer data flow", "Platform"], [countSeries], "rules")
countSeries = Series("Rules", [6, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1])
table = Table([colGroup, colRule, colRef])
colGroup = Col("Subsystem", ["Sync & local data (6)", "", "", "", "", "", "Identity & auth (3)", "", "", "Telemetry (3)", "", "", "Wire compatibility (2)", "", "Renderer data flow (2)", "", "Platform (1)"])
colRule = Col("Rule", ["Every read of granted data is local", "Chat is the sync unit", "synced_through_rev advances contiguously", "ord is never renumbered or reused", "last_read_ord is a max-register", "Message IDs are client-generated", "No identity reference below Layer 2", "Auth failure never clears local data", "An actor write is paired with recordActor", "No message body in telemetry, ever", "No unbounded id as a metric label", "The renderer holds no telemetry SDK", "An unknown event type still advances the cursor", "Inbound frames parse permissively, never .strict()", "Every renderer read goes through the live-query client", "Write and read sides share one topic vocabulary", "No native SQLite binding"])
colRef = Col("Source", ["DESIGN §3", "DESIGN §7.1", "DESIGN §8.1", "DESIGN §8.1", "DESIGN §4", "DESIGN §10.1", "DESIGN §6.3", "DESIGN §13.1", "SYNC-FLOWS §9.1", "OBSERVABILITY §6", "OBSERVABILITY §5", "OBSERVABILITY §3", "DESIGN §9.10", "DESIGN §9.10", "FRONTEND §5", "DESIGN §14, inv. 68", "DESIGN §13.5"])
next = Actions([apply])
apply = Reply("Write this into AGENTS.md", "Rewrite the Non-negotiables table in AGENTS.md grouped by subsystem, with a count per group, keeping each rule's full explanation.", true)

reply:
I haven't changed AGENTS.md yet. The grouping above is only a view. The table doesn't label subsystems, so I chose the groups myself. Two rules could have gone either way:

- **Actors are paired with `recordActor`:** I put this under identity. It could also go under sync, since its source is SYNC-FLOWS.
- **The renderer holds no telemetry SDK:** I put this under telemetry. It's also a renderer rule, but the reason for it is about telemetry.

If you want this in the file, I'd make one sub-heading per group with its count, like `### Sync & local data (6)`, and a two-column table under each. That keeps each rule's full explanation. AGENTS.md already has changes you haven't committed, so I'd only edit that section.
